title: Sydney medical student identifies 5 relatives in forgotten 1965 film after social media appeal
summary_full: A 1965 film uncovered in Melbourne became a bridge connecting a Sydney medical student to previously unknown relatives. This discovery showcased three generations of his family outside their residence in Mitcham. After British director Karen Walsh endeavored to uncover the family's identity, the medical student recognized his great-grandmother among the footage shared online. With the help of ABC Melbourne, the quest for family links successfully culminated.
